summary.text: Dan Ankeles is a Democratic state representative from Maine House District 100, in office since December 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Brett Barrett.

paragraphs.text: Ankeles was born in Peabody, Massachusetts, graduated from Phillips Academy, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Chicago in 2004.
His career experience includes work as a public radio producer, field organizer and legislative aide.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Ankeles described himself as a former journalist, Brunswick town councilor and legislative staffer, and said he had passed three bills in his first term, including a law to make it easier to get grant money to repair Brunswick Landing infrastructure.

He said he used his seat on the Transportation Committee to help authorize the Mountain Division Rail trail and that, as a member of the Appropriations Committee, he helped fund $72 million in new housing.
He listed trail expansion, bike and pedestrian safety, climate resilience, and the housing and workforce shortages among his policy interests.
